Diego —

Thanks for the summary and the attach. Finance policy: by default Procurement requires a PO for any subscription or vendor relationship where monthly spend exceeds $500. That said, we can approve a short, controlled exception for pilots with the following mandated controls:

1) Temporary exception window capped at 60 days and a maximum total spend of $6,000.
2) Vendor must submit a W-9 and a primary billing contact.
3) All invoices should be sent to finance@redwood.inference and include the reference "Pilot — PO Pending"; invoices must break out line items and dates.
4) Payment method: Finance prefers vendor invoicing to be paid via ACH; credit card is acceptable for immediate/one-off charges but we want ACH for monthlies.
5) Legal sign-off: Aditya should approve the temporary language in the MSA/addendum clarifying that a PO may be added retroactively and Redwood reserves the right to stop payments if terms are breached.

If the vendor accepts these controls and Legal signs off, Finance will provisionally approve the invoice-only onboarding for the 60-day pilot. Please send the W-9 and a short MSA addendum draft for review.

— Laura
